verdict.rationale: Eqvista's pricing page lists "Board Resolutions & Voting" as a Premium feature, and its cap-table page cites integrated board management tools, so it has a first-party governance capability. Its built-in e-signing is documented only for equity agreements, certificates and SAFEs, not for consents. Missing for 10: documentation that board consents and stockholder approvals are drafted in-product, evidence they are routed for e-signature, archiving or linking of approvals to the transactions they authorize, any stockholder-approval workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
